earthquake.summary: The quake scorecard is uninformative. No verified barrio damage labels were available, so no ranking or precision score was produced. Co-event coherence remains withheld pending the freeze.

flood.summary: PROVISIONAL, measured 2026-06-17. NISAR mapped 4,487 ha of absolute open water (5,539 of 197,758 valid pixels). Threshold sensitivity: 2,799–6,726 ha. The thresholds are uncalibrated and the dry reference does not support change classes. The staged Sentinel scenes provide context and were acquired on different dates.
flood.source: reports/mojana.md · Absolute open water and sensitivity
